Does not authorize Phase-0, confirmatory ALR, A3↔A4, or four-arm. Does not authorize 14B/32B. Does not soften EXPERIENCE_V1_EXACT_STRUCTURED_MATCH thresholds. unit_of_analysis.primary_gate_unit: Per ORACLE_PROCEDURE_UPPER_BOUND job: FRESH_TRANSFER exact-success rate over the sealed transfer task set, where exact success requires score==1.0 under EXPERIENCE_V1_EXACT_STRUCTURED_MATCH (verdict match + required support/reject recall).

gate_thresholds.capable_model_available_rule: CAPABLE_MODEL_AVAILABLE flips true only when an authorized v2-or-later ORACLE receipt at an authorized scale (<=7B under this packet) records success_rate >= 2/3 with parse-valid outputs on the frozen v2 sealed transfer set. Stratum profiles and mean_score never clear the gate alone.

Dropping HOSTILE_NEAR_MISS or CROSS_DOMAIN_TRANSFER from the gate set because 7B failed them
Choosing a larger model because RAKL look bad under 7B

predicted_discriminator.question: Under unchanged EXPERIENCE_V1_EXACT_STRUCTURED_MATCH thresholds and a sealed transfer set that still includes CROSS_DOMAIN evidence-binding and HOSTILE_NEAR_MISS QoI discrimination, can any authorized-scale (<=7B) ORACLE_PROCEDURE_UPPER_BOUND job achieve exact success_rate >= 2/3?
